    text = month + ' ' + day.zfill(2) + ' ' + time
    dt = datetime.strptime(text, '%b %d %H:%M:%S')
    monotonic = (dt.month - 1) * 31 * 86400 + (int(day) - 1) * 86400 + dt.hour * 3600 + dt.minute * 60 + dt.second
    return {'stored': [monotonic], 'layout': [len(sp1), len(sp2), len(day)]}

def inverse(record):
    monotonic = int(record['stored'][0])
    layout = record.get('layout', [])
    sp1_len, sp2_len, day_width = layout
    seconds = monotonic % 60
    minutes = (monotonic // 60) % 60
    hours = (monotonic // 3600) % 24
    days = (monotonic // 86400) % 31 + 1
    months = (monotonic // (31 * 86400)) + 1
    dt = datetime(1900, months, days, hours, minutes, seconds)
    month = dt.strftime('%b')
    day = str(dt.day).zfill(day_width)
    time = dt.strftime('%H:%M:%S')
